field.name: mp_bona_fide_resident
field.comment: True if taxpayer meets bona fide resident test for CNMI

field.name: mp_calculated_tax
field.comment: Tax calculated using federal rates (before rebate)

field.name: mp_closer_connection
field.comment: True if taxpayer has closer connection to CNMI than US

field.name: mp_days_present
field.comment: Number of days present in CNMI during tax year (183+ required)

field.name: mp_files_with_cnmi_dof
field.comment: True if taxpayer files with CNMI Division of Revenue and Tax

field.name: mp_files_with_irs
field.comment: True if taxpayer also files with IRS (partial-year or non-resident)

field.name: mp_has_tax_home
field.comment: True if taxpayer has tax home in CNMI

field.name: mp_income_tax
field.comment: Final CNMI income tax after rebate

field.name: mp_rebate_tier_1_limit
field.comment: First rebate tier limit - 90% rebate if tax <= $20k

field.name: mp_rebate_tier_2_limit
field.comment: Second rebate tier limit - 70% on excess over $20k

field.name: mp_rebate_tier_3_rate
field.comment: Rebate rate for tier 3 - 50% on excess over $100k

field.name: mp_requires_form_5074
field.comment: True if taxpayer must file Form 5074 (income allocation)

field.name: mp_uses_federal_rates
field.comment: CNMI uses mirror code (same as federal tax code)
